page.title: Hub exit rate
page.description: Pull inbound waybills by arrival date, then use searchWaybill deliveryTime as hub-exit time. Same-day = by 23:59:59 on arrival day; next-morning = next calendar day 00:00–11:00 inclusive. Weekends are not skipped. Results are not stored.

filter.rangeHint: Up to 7 days; each day is aligned to its own arrival date
filter.querying: Fetching inbound and waybill details — large stations may take a few minutes

toast.selectStation: Select a station in the top bar first
toast.maxRange: Arrival date range cannot exceed 7 days

empty: Pick arrival dates and run a query

kpi.sameDayHint: {{count}} exited by 23:59:59 on the arrival day
kpi.nextMorningHint: {{count}} exited between 00:00 and 11:00 the next day

hourly.title: Hourly exit (aligned to arrival day)
hourly.subtitle: Bars = incremental share that hour; line = cumulative. Click a table row to filter by vendor / route / courier.
hourly.matrixHideZeroHint: Route and courier only: hide rows with 0 exits in every 7–11am hour
